items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that keeps dry, easily flushed-looking skin comfortable.
A ceramide moisturizer to support the skin barrier and ease the dry, tight look.
A mineral SPF 50 is a gentler daily choice for skin that looks red and reactive.

response.routine_note: Keep to these three gentle steps (cleanse, moisturize, mineral SPF in the morning) and avoid strong actives, scrubs and hot water, so I'm not recommending anything 'strong' here. Persistent flushing with bumps and gritty, irritated eyes is better assessed by a dermatologist or eye-care professional than by anything a shop can sell, so please book a visit.
